metadata.description: Engineering standards pack: opinionated Claude Code plugins for living documentation, agile alignment, and contract-first verification.

plugins.name: pragmatic-codewiki
plugins.description: Maintains a pragmatic, always-current code wiki: detects drift between code and docs, and updates only the pages the change actually touched.

plugins.name: scrum-master
plugins.description: Keeps engineering work aligned to the agile artifacts: turns vague requests into well-formed backlog items and checks work in progress against sprint scope.

plugins.name: contract-masterplan
plugins.description: Enforces contract-first delivery: derives the API/schema contract before implementation and verifies producers and consumers against it.
